targets: Thoracic rotation mobility; pectoral and anterior shoulder flexibility

summary.en: Lying on your side with knees bent, open your top arm like a book cover and follow it with your eyes.
summary.ru: Karwat letkar ghutne modein aur upar wala bazu kitab ke cover ki tarah kholein, nazar bazu ke saath chalayein.

indications: Shoulder and neck tension related to a stiff upper back
contraindications: Shoulder pain on reaching back that does not ease with a smaller range
Recent rib or spinal fracture unless cleared

safety.en: Keep your knees together and rotate only through your upper back.
safety.ru: Ghutne jore rakhein aur sirf peeth ke upar wale hisse se ghoomein.

equipment: Mat or bed; pillow for the head

setup.en: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent and both arms straight in front, palms together.
setup.ru: Karwat letein, kulhe aur ghutne mude hue, dono bazu aage seedhe, hatheliyan milli hui.

steps.en: Slowly lift the top arm and open it up and back, turning your chest towards the ceiling.
steps.ru: Upar wala bazu aahista uthayein aur kholte hue peeche le jayein, seena chhat ki taraf ghumayein.

steps.en: Follow your hand with your eyes; keep your knees together.
steps.ru: Nazar haath ke saath chalayein; ghutne jore rakhein.

steps.en: Pause, then bring the arm back to meet the other hand.
steps.ru: Thora ruken, phir bazu wapis doosre haath se milayein.

breathing.en: Breathe in as you open, out as you return.
breathing.ru: Kholte waqt saans andar, wapis aate waqt bahar.

mistakes.en: Knees lifting apart
Rotating only the arm, not the chest

progressions: Hold the open position with deep breaths
regressions: Support the top arm on a pillow

say.en: Open the arm like a book and follow it with your eyes.
say.ru: Bazu kitab ki tarah kholein aur nazar uske saath chalayein.

summary.en: Sitting tall with arms crossed on your chest, turn your upper body to one side and back.
summary.ru: Seedhe baith kar bazu seene par crossed karein aur upar ka jism ek taraf ghumayein, phir wapis.

indications: Warm-up before shoulder or trunk exercises
contraindications: Back pain that spreads into the leg on rotation
Recent rib or spinal fracture unless cleared

safety.en: Keep your hips facing forward and turn only as far as is comfortable.
safety.ru: Kulhe samne rakhein aur sirf utna ghoomein jitna aaram se ho.

setup.en: Sit tall with your feet flat and your arms crossed over your chest.
setup.ru: Seedhe baith jayein, paon sapaat, bazu seene par crossed.

steps.en: Keep your hips still and turn your chest slowly to the right.
steps.ru: Kulhe sakit rakhein aur seena aahista daayen taraf ghumayein.

steps.en: Hold briefly at the comfortable end.
steps.ru: Aaram dah aakhir par thori der hold karein.

steps.en: Return to the middle and turn to the other side.
steps.ru: Darmiyan mein aayein aur doosri taraf ghumayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you rotate; in as you return.
breathing.ru: Ghoomte waqt saans bahar; wapis aate waqt andar.

mistakes.en: Twisting through the hips or lower back
Slumping forward

say.en: Turn your chest — hips stay facing forward.

name.ru: Kursi par peeth ko peeche jhukana (extension)

targets: Thoracic extension mobility; counters prolonged flexed posture

summary.en: Sitting with hands behind your head, gently lean the upper back over the top of the chair back and lift your chest.
summary.ru: Haath sar ke peeche rakh kar peeth ke upar wale hisse ko kursi ke peeche wale hisse par aahista peeche jhukayein aur seena upar uthayein.

indications: Neck and shoulder tension related to desk posture
contraindications: Neck pain when the hands are behind the head (support the head instead)
Osteoporosis with vertebral fracture risk unless cleared
Pain in the low back — keep the movement in the upper back

safety.en: The movement is in the middle of your back, not your low back or neck.
safety.ru: Harkat peeth ke beech mein hai, kamar ya gardan mein nahi.

setup.en: Sit tall with your hands supporting the back of your head, elbows forward.
setup.ru: Seedhe baith jayein, haath sar ke peeche sahare ke liye, kohniyan aage.

steps.en: Draw your shoulder blades gently together.
steps.ru: Kandhon ki haddiyan aahista milayein.

steps.en: Lean back over the top of the chair back, lifting your chest towards the ceiling.
steps.ru: Kursi ki peeth ke upar peeche jhukein aur seena chhat ki taraf uthayein.

steps.en: Return to upright and repeat.
steps.ru: Wapis seedhe hon aur dohrayein.

breathing.en: Breathe in as you extend; out as you come up.
breathing.ru: Peeche jhukte waqt saans andar; wapis aate waqt bahar.

mistakes.en: Bending in the low back instead of the mid-back
mistakes.ru: Beech ki jagah kamar se jhukna

mistakes.en: Dropping the head back

say.en: Lean back over the chair and open the chest.
say.ru: Kursi par peeche jhukein aur seena kholein.

targets: Whole-spine flexion–extension mobility; gentle trunk muscle activation

summary.en: On hands and knees, slowly round your back up like a cat, then sink it gently like a camel.
summary.ru: Haath aur ghutno par aakar peeth ko billi ki tarah upar ghol karein, phir oont ki tarah aahista neeche karein.

indications: Warm-up before core and back exercises
contraindications: Wrist or knee pain on weight-bearing (pad or modify)
Pain at the end of range that does not settle

safety.en: Move slowly within a comfortable range — never force the end positions.
safety.ru: Aahista aur aaram dah range mein harkat karein — aakhir par zor na lagayein.

setup.en: On hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
setup.ru: Haath aur ghutno par, haath kandhon ke neeche, ghutne kulhon ke neeche.

steps.en: Tuck your chin and slowly round your whole back up towards the ceiling.
steps.ru: Chin andar karein aur poori peeth ko aahista chhat ki taraf gol karein.

steps.en: Then slowly lower the belly and lift your head and tailbone.
steps.ru: Phir pait aahista neeche karein aur sar aur tailbone upar uthayein.

steps.en: Return to the middle position and repeat smoothly.
steps.ru: Darmiyani position mein aayein aur aaram se dohrayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you round up; breathe in as you sink down.
breathing.ru: Gol karte waqt saans bahar; neeche karte waqt andar.

mistakes.en: Moving fast or bouncing at the end
mistakes.ru: Tez harkat ya aakhir par jhatke

mistakes.en: Shifting the hips backwards

say.en: Tuck your chin and round your back up like a cat.
say.ru: Chin andar karein aur peeth ko billi ki tarah upar ghol karein.

say.en: Now let your belly sink and lift your head like a camel.
say.ru: Ab pait neeche jane dein aur oont ki tarah sar uthayein.

summary.en: On hands and knees, place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up towards the ceiling.
summary.ru: Haath aur ghutno par ek haath sar ke peeche rakhein aur kohni ko chhat ki taraf ghumayein.

indications: Rotation loss in the upper back
contraindications: Wrist, knee or shoulder pain when weight-bearing
Neck pain with the hand behind the head (place the hand on the lower back instead)

safety.en: Rotate through your upper back; keep your hips still.
safety.ru: Peeth ke upar wale hisse se ghoomein; kulhe sakit rakhein.

setup.en: On hands and knees. Place one hand lightly behind your head.
setup.ru: Haath aur ghutno par. Ek haath halke se sar ke peeche rakhein.

steps.en: Rotate and lift the elbow towards the ceiling, following it with your eyes.
steps.ru: Kohni ko chhat ki taraf ghumayein aur uthayein, nazar uske saath.

steps.en: Keep the hips level and the supporting arm straight.
steps.ru: Kulhe barabar aur sahara dene wala bazu seedha rakhein.

steps.en: Slowly return and bring the elbow down towards the opposite elbow.
steps.ru: Aahista wapis aayein aur kohni ko doosri kohni ki taraf layein.

breathing.en: Breathe in as you open; out as you return.
breathing.ru: Kholte waqt saans andar; wapis aate waqt bahar.

mistakes.en: Hips swaying sideways
Pulling on the head with the hand

progressions: Hold the open position for 5 s

say.en: Keep one hand on the mat, and turn your chest to lift the other elbow up to the ceiling. Follow it with your eyes.
say.ru: Ek haath mat par rakhein, seena ghuma kar doosri kohni chhat ki taraf uthayein. Nazar uske saath rakhein.

name.ru: Pait ke bal chest lift (peeth extension)

targets: Thoracic and lumbar extensors (erector spinae, multifidus); postural endurance

summary.en: Lying face down with hands behind your head, lift your chest a few centimetres off the mat and lower it with control.
summary.ru: Pait ke bal let kar haath sar ke peeche rakhein, seena mat se chand centimetre uthayein aur control se neeche layein.

contraindications: Pain in the low back when lifting
Osteoporosis with vertebral fracture unless cleared
Neck pain with hands behind the head (keep arms by the sides)

safety.en: Lift only a little — your face should stay close to the mat and your neck long.
safety.ru: Sirf thora uthayein — chehra mat ke qareeb aur gardan lambi rahe.

equipment: Mat; small towel under the forehead

setup.en: Lie face down, forehead resting on a towel, hands lightly behind your head.
setup.ru: Munh neeche letein, mathay ke neeche tauliya, haath halke se sar ke peeche.

steps.en: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and gently lift your chest.
steps.ru: Kandhon ki haddiyan milayein aur seena aahista uthayein.

steps.en: Keep your neck in line with your spine — look at the floor.
steps.ru: Gardan ko reerh ki seedh mein rakhein — zameen ki taraf dekhein.

steps.en: Hold, then lower slowly.
steps.ru: Hold karein, phir aahista neeche aayein.

breathing.en: Breathe out as you lift; keep breathing during the hold.
breathing.ru: Uthate waqt saans bahar; hold mein saans lete rahein.

mistakes.en: Lifting too high and arching the low back
mistakes.ru: Zyada upar uthana aur kamar arch karna

mistakes.en: Looking up and cranking the neck
mistakes.ru: Upar dekh kar gardan ko mora dena

progressions: Arms in a Y or T shape

say.en: Lift the chest a little — keep the neck long.
say.ru: Seena thora uthayein — gardan lambi rakhein.

targets: Diaphragm; breathing pattern and breathlessness control

summary.en: Lying with knees bent, breathe in slowly through the nose so the tummy rises, then breathe out gently through the mouth.
summary.ru: Ghutne mod kar let jayein, naak se aahista saans lein ke pait upar uthe, phir munh se aaram se saans bahar nikalein.

indications: Breathlessness in COPD or asthma (breathing control)
Anxiety and stress with fast, shallow breathing
Pelvic floor and core retraining (the first step)
contraindications: Severe breathlessness at rest — seek medical help
Chest pain
Dizziness or tingling from breathing too deeply (slow down)

safety.en: Breathe slowly and gently, not deeply and hard. Stop if you feel dizzy.
safety.ru: Aahista aur halki saans lein, zor se gehri nahi. Chakkar aayein to ruk jayein.

safety.en: Chest pain or breathlessness that does not settle: get medical help.
safety.ru: Seene mein dard ya saans ki takleef jo theek na ho: foran doctor se rabta karein.

equipment: Bed or mat; a pillow under the head

setup.en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat. Relax your shoulders and rest your arms by your sides.
setup.ru: Peeth ke bal let jayein, ghutne mude aur paon sapaat. Kandhe dheele aur bazu paas rakhein.

steps.en: Breathe in slowly through your nose for about 3 seconds. Let your tummy rise; your upper chest stays quiet.
steps.ru: Naak se lagbhag 3 second aahista saans lein. Pait upar uthe; seene ka upar wala hissa sakit rahe.

steps.en: Pause for a moment.
steps.ru: Ek lamha ruk jayein.

steps.en: Breathe out gently through slightly open lips for about 4 to 6 seconds; the tummy sinks.
steps.ru: Halke khule honton se 4 se 6 second aaram se saans bahar nikalein; pait neeche jaye.

breathing.en: In through the nose, out slowly through the mouth. Breathing out takes longer than breathing in.
breathing.ru: Andar naak se, bahar aahista munh se. Bahar ki saans andar wali se lambi ho.

mistakes.en: Lifting the shoulders and chest to breathe
mistakes.ru: Saans ke liye kandhe aur seena uthana

mistakes.en: Breathing too deeply and fast (it causes dizziness)
mistakes.ru: Bohat gehri aur tez saans lena (is se chakkar aate hain)

mistakes.en: Pushing the tummy out with force
mistakes.ru: Pait ko zor se bahar dhakelna

dosage.frequency: 3 times a day, and when breathless

progressions: Use it while walking (breathe in for 2 steps, out for 3 to 4 steps)
regressions: Lie propped up on two pillows

say.en: Breathe in slowly through your nose. Let your tummy rise.
say.ru: Naak se aahista saans lein. Pait ko upar uthne dein.

say.en: Now breathe out gently through your lips. The tummy sinks.
say.ru: Ab honton se aaram se saans bahar nikalein. Pait neeche jaye.

targets: Breathing rate and breathlessness control; airway support during exhalation

summary.en: Sitting tall, breathe in through the nose, then breathe out slowly through pursed lips, as if blowing out a candle gently.
summary.ru: Seedhe baith kar naak se saans lein, phir honth sikor kar aahista saans bahar nikalein, jaise mombatti ko aaram se phoonk rahe hon.

contraindications: Severe breathlessness at rest, blue lips or confusion — emergency care
Chest pain

safety.en: This eases breathlessness; it does not replace your inhaler or oxygen. Use them as prescribed.
safety.ru: Is se saans ki takleef kam hoti hai; ye inhaler ya oxygen ka badal nahi. Unhein doctor ke kehne ke mutabiq istemal karein.

setup.en: Sit tall on a chair with both feet on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs. Relax your shoulders.
setup.ru: Kursi par seedhe baithein, dono paon zameen par, haath thighs par. Kandhe dheele rakhein.

steps.en: Breathe in through your nose for a count of 2.
steps.ru: Naak se 2 ginti tak saans lein.

steps.en: Purse your lips as if to whistle.
steps.ru: Honth aise sikorein jaise seeti bajane lage hon.

steps.en: Breathe out slowly and evenly through your lips for a count of 4. Do not force the air out.
steps.ru: Honton se aahista aur barabar 4 ginti tak saans bahar nikalein. Zor se hawa na nikalein.

breathing.en: In for 2 through the nose, out for 4 through pursed lips.
breathing.ru: Naak se 2 tak andar, sikre honton se 4 tak bahar.

mistakes.en: Blowing out hard
Hunching the shoulders
Breathing in through the mouth

dosage.frequency: Several times a day, and during any activity that makes you breathless

progressions: Use it while walking and on stairs
Combine with a forward-lean rest position

say.en: Breathe in through your nose for two.
say.ru: Naak se do tak saans lein.

say.en: Purse your lips and breathe out slowly for four.
say.ru: Honth sikorein aur chaar tak aahista saans bahar nikalein.

name.en: Deep breath with arm raise (chest expansion)
name.ru: Bazu utha kar gehri saans (chest expansion)

targets: Chest wall expansion, thoracic extension and shoulder elevation with breathing

summary.en: Sitting tall, raise both arms forwards and up as you breathe in, then lower them slowly as you breathe out.
summary.ru: Seedhe baith kar saans lete hue dono bazu aage se upar uthayein, phir saans chhodte hue aahista neeche layein.

indications: Reduced chest expansion after chest or abdominal surgery
Breathing exercises in COPD and after pneumonia
Stiff upper back and rounded posture
contraindications: Recent shoulder surgery or dislocation (follow your surgeon's limits)
Sternotomy in the first 6 to 8 weeks: keep both arms below shoulder height unless cleared
Dizziness

safety.en: Lift only as high as is comfortable. After heart surgery, follow your team's arm limits.
safety.ru: Sirf utna uthayein jitna aaram se ho. Dil ke operation ke baad apni team ki batayi hui hadd ka khayal rakhein.

setup.en: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat and your hands on your thighs.
setup.ru: Kursi par seedhe baithein, paon sapaat aur haath thighs par.

steps.en: Breathe in slowly and deeply as you raise both arms forwards and up.
steps.ru: Aahista gehri saans lete hue dono bazu aage se upar uthayein.

steps.en: At the top, hold your breath for 2 to 3 seconds if comfortable.
steps.ru: Upar pohanch kar, aaram ho to 2 se 3 second saans rokein.

steps.en: Breathe out slowly as you lower your arms.
steps.ru: Bazu neeche laate hue aahista saans bahar nikalein.

breathing.en: In as the arms go up, a short hold at the top, out as they come down.
breathing.ru: Bazu upar jaate hue saans andar, upar thora hold, neeche aate hue saans bahar.

mistakes.en: Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears
Arching the lower back to reach higher
mistakes.ru: Zyada upar pohanchne ke liye kamar arch karna

mistakes.en: Breathing fast

progressions: Add a gentle huff (forced breath out) after every third breath, to clear phlegm
regressions: Raise the arms only to shoulder height

say.en: Breathe in deeply as you raise your arms.
say.ru: Bazu uthate hue gehri saans lein.
